original_benchmark.notes: EvoEval release v0.1.0 (evo-eval/evoeval_release), evaluator evo-eval/evoeval@d5ca3104 (= PyPI evoeval 0.1.0). The original harness prompts an LLM once per problem (greedy pass@1); it has no agent. Six other EvoEval datasets exist (creative, subtle, combine, tool_use: 100 each; verbose, concise: 164 each); they can be generated with --dataset but are out of scope and unverified.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on all 100 EvoEval_difficult tasks, 3 runs per side: original 57.67 ± 1.20 (runs 56, 60, 57), Harbor 60.33 ± 0.67 (runs 59, 61, 61), ranges overlap. evoeval-codegen (evoeval_auto.parity_agent:EvoEvalCodegenAgent) is the original EvoEval code-generation harness for API chat models implemented as a Harbor agent. Standard CLI agent check: terminus-2@2.0.0 + deepseek-v4.1-flash, 1 run, 64/100. parity_costs unknown (gateway pricing not available).
